research-intake.work: Research Question Card, evidence needs, support/falsification criteria and minimal next action
research-intake.boundary: Intake only; preserve latest user scope and existing fixed question.

topic-novelty.work: Apply suitable ideation lenses to the given problem; compare candidates and decisive tests
topic-novelty.boundary: Open topics use brainstorming; fixed questions use scholar-intake evidence/gap subflow, without restarting open ideation.

literature-discovery.work: Bounded retrieval, screen real records and synthesize source-supported findings
literature-discovery.boundary: No abstract or search snippet treated as full-text evidence.

paper-deep-reading.work: Read the relevant original material, extract grounded findings and record exact locators
paper-deep-reading.boundary: Partial material remains partial; no full-paper reading claim from an abstract.

research-design.work: Map claims to decisive checks, controls, dependencies, run order and stopping rules
research-design.boundary: Study design invokes kdense-design when assignment/randomization is the actual task; no native cross-model audit claimed.

data-discovery.work: Define retrieval contract, select authoritative source, verify filters and record access/provenance
data-discovery.boundary: Existing provided sources may be assessed without downloading; unknown rights remain unresolved.

data-preparation.work: Profile actual format and units, diagnose missingness and apply justified transformations
data-preparation.boundary: Only real data and actual performed transformations.

analysis-execution.work: Apply appropriate analysis to real inputs, compare baselines and bound interpretation
analysis-execution.boundary: Statistical/descriptive tasks use KDense; ML analysis bundles use Scholar. Formal proof or interpretive tasks require a verified matching entry before proceeding.

robustness-reproducibility.work: Appraise units, bias, assumptions and replication; perform the requested rerun/check and bind findings
robustness-reproducibility.boundary: Appraisal alone cannot certify software rerun; retain executed commands/results when rerun requested.

scientific-visualization.work: Plan claim, choose chart, produce/edit and review numeric accuracy and final-size visual expression
scientific-visualization.boundary: Reference examples may supplement this main professional workflow, not replace it.

manuscript-writing.work: Evidence outline, draft within facts, reconcile methods/results and review affected content
manuscript-writing.boundary: Partial writing stays within requested section; no forced full study or human approval claim.

manuscript-review.work: Review actual manuscript/evidence and return grounded issues with revision priorities
manuscript-review.boundary: Current-host review is not independent cross-model peer review.

citation-audit.work: Check actual identifiers/metadata, cited propositions and source locators; correct or flag gaps
citation-audit.boundary: Metadata success alone is not proposition verification.

journal-intelligence.work: Resolve exact target and article type, consult official guidance, assess scope/audience and document fit limits
journal-intelligence.boundary: Ranking/matching must use actual journal scope sources; no invented acceptance likelihood.

ethics-protocol.work: Apply confidentiality, authorship, permissions and actual ethics/declaration evidence; prepare unresolved items
ethics-protocol.boundary: Authorship/declaration subflow; institutional approval or jurisdiction-specific advice needs actual authoritative sources; never fabricate approval.

peer-review-response.work: Classify all comments, choose strategies, revise evidence/prose and write evidence-based responses with locations
peer-review-response.boundary: Preserve confidential boundary; no invented completed changes or experiments.

submission-packaging.work: Check official current target rules, assemble actual manuscript/supplements and check package consistency
submission-packaging.boundary: Preparation only; external submission requires actual user authorization.

publication-stewardship.work: Apply integrity/declaration and revision workflows to affected published claims, evidence and correction materials
publication-stewardship.boundary: Prepare accountable correction/version records; no automatic contact, publishing or platform mutation.

final-expression.work: Revise actual expression and argument while preserving evidence, then recheck facts and scope
final-expression.boundary: Cannot remove material uncertainty or strengthen unsupported claims.

presentation.work: Apply audience/storyboard and actual deck workflow with source-backed content and rendering review
presentation.boundary: Image-page assembly is function-only, insufficient for the full presentation workflow.

workbench.work: Apply requested local production/validation/recovery subflow to current claim-bound artifacts
workbench.boundary: Do not claim app/backend launch or full workbench execution from a local checker.

discovery: Source-first professional steps are mandatory; missing matching source blocks the step. Preparation alone is not execution.
